query:
INSERT INTO blob_objects (
                        file_hash,
                        file_size,
                        compression,
                        r2_key
                    )
                    SELECT
                        file_hash,
                        file_size,
                        compression,
                        r2_upload_key
                    FROM upload_sessions
                    WHERE cache_id = $1
                        AND file_hash IS NOT NULL
                        AND r2_upload_key IS NOT NULL
                        AND NOT STARTS_WITH(r2_upload_key, 'staging/')
                    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
